limits: This evaluates immediate reward ranking under a balanced random behavior-state distribution, not multi-step return or closed-loop policy benefit.
The full hidden simulator state is used only by the offline counterfactual evaluator; the agent receives observations and realized behavior transitions only.
The contextual adapter changes predicted states but not the reward head, so the audit distinguishes reward-head ranking from total EFE ranking.
Repeated anchors within a seed are summarized at seed level; this is one agent initialization and one synthetic world.
Equal behavior trajectories make arm comparisons paired at state/action-stream level, but they do not establish performance under either arm's own induced state distribution.

protocol.anchors: same episode states and observations for baseline and adapter; independent balanced-random behavior actions; agents observe the same executed behavior transition
protocol.counterfactual: deep-copy the complete environment at each anchor; execute every action from the identical world and RNG state; verify the executed behavior branch exactly matches the actual transition
protocol.primary_outcome: per-seed mean immediate regret of the proposed action against the best of four exact one-step reward branches
